notes: Vowel rule 2, O-Fronting (p. 54): *pose > pese 'paddle', *pogu > peŋ 'turtle', *kadroRa > kndere 'cuscus'; left-to-right iterative. *tanoq > tono (no fronting after a back vowel).
Vowel rule 3, U-Assimilation to i (p. 54): *qupi > kiu 'yam', *tapuRi > twiri 'conch shell', *pudi > pir 'banana'; i does not assimilate to a following u (*pitiqun > ptik 'star').

Vowel rule 4a, I-Lowering (p. 55): *Raqi > re 'southeast wind', *kori > kere 'scrape'; not after o (*Rapi > rou 'afternoon', n. 19). Some forms without 4a and 4b are loans that came in while 4d was active (n. 18).

Vowel rule 4b, A-Harmony (p. 56): a assimilates in rounding to a preceding or following low or mid vowel: *mate > mete 'die', *mena > mene 'sago', *tanoq > tono 'land', *kauR > ko 'bamboo', *namuk > nomnom 'mosquito'.

Vowel rule 4c, A-Assimilation to Glides (p. 56): *kayu > ke 'tree', *laya > le 'sail'; a preceding y has no effect (*maya > mia- 'tongue', n. 24).
